start_rule: All ten predecessor terminal checkpoints, complete paired intervention grids, and four finished lanes must verify before any third-seed training starts
recipe_rule: Preserve predecessor frozen trainer/evaluator code and all config fields except seed, experiment/trainer identity and results_root
primary_endpoint: study-wise positive-GT WT/TC/ET region-macro Dice, equal-fold mean
aggregate_policy: Report all fifteen model-fold cells and all three seed pairs; seeds are repeated fits of the same patients, not additional cohorts

normalization_followup.status: registered_for_after_all_fifteen_models; not implemented or launched by this queue
normalization_followup.selection_rule: Use the same saved validation membership, all folds and seeds; no favorable-checkpoint selection
measurements: surviving-mixture spatial variance relative to actual epsilon
paired drop versus renormalized-drop post-normalization tensor differences
paired downstream logits, masks and Dice differences
